decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 18th December 2006, the erection of a new roof extension with four roof windows to front of house with rear dormer 3.60m projection, 2.30m high at the top not exceeding the roofline of the original house, 4.50m wide, and side dormer 3.10m projection, 2.70m high not exceeding the roofline of the original house, 3.70m wide was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls inside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed extension has a volume of under 40cubic metres.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a roof extension to the rear roofslope and side roof slope over the existing two storey rear extension, insertion of 4 X rooflights to the front roofslope with a loft conversion to create habitable roof space to the house
